item.title: Drake’s Rolex From the ‘Take Care’ Cover Has Reportedly Sold for $500,000
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our show, where we dive into the latest news and trends. Today, we're talking about a piece of hip-hop history that's just been sold for a whopping six figures. Drake's Rolex from his 2011 Take Care album cover art has reportedly been sold for $500,000.
[Short music transition]
Host: According to WatchPro, the gold Rolex GMT Master II was sold by Wind Vintage, and it's a significant sale - $400,000 over its market value. The watch features an OVO owl engraving on the backside and was famously worn by Drake on the cover of Take Care and in the "Marvin's Room" music video.
[Short music transition]
Host: For those who may not know, Take Care was a huge success, debuting at number one on the Billboard 200 chart and selling over 631,000 units in its first week. The album's lead single, "Marvin's Room", peaked at number 21 on the Billboard Hot 100. And, fun fact, Drake has often rapped about his love of luxury watches, including his Rolexes, throughout his career.
[Short music transition]
Host: The collectible watch market is apparently hotter than ever, with Wind Vintage's Eric Wind saying that they're selling watches within minutes of listing them online. It's clear that there's a strong demand for unique and rare timepieces like this one.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in. We'll be keeping an eye on Drake's upcoming album, Iceman, which drops on May 15. Will he rhyme about his favorite watches again? We'll have to wait and see. Until next time, goodbye!
